jepa_development.baseline: Official pretrained JEPA-WM + locally native-trained pose readout; not complete official planner
jepa_development.scope: Previously inspected development bank. Physical scheme has additional geometry/camera/controller priors and a single deterministic fit; no fair architecture-only or unseen closed-loop superiority claim.

contact_only.scope: paired scene uncertainty for this fixed model pair; not training-seed uncertainty

property_auxiliary.scope: paired scene uncertainty for this fixed model pair; not training-seed uncertainty

physion_released_test.scope: Same frozen V-JEPA-2 ViT-L observation representation; additional training-release supervision. Previously inspected released test, not fresh confirmation. Does not compare against official complete JEPA planning or unknown BAIZ protocol.

kinejing_local.scope: Single seed, previously explored public development examples; feature prediction only, not RGB quality or official benchmark.

state_position_test.scope: Privileged simulator state at inference; exploration uses true block state; no RGB model, no closed-loop success evidence, simulator only.

cnn_position_test.scope: State-supervised simulator CNN on PushT. No closed-loop control or novel method.

visual_position_test.scope: Renderer-specific visual state features, simulated state supervision; no closed-loop superiority.

geometry_point_goal_test.scope: Known prior-art object-frame baseline; exact simulator state, zero-velocity constructed states, four point goals. Point-goal regret is not PushT coverage reward or RGB control.

planner_memory_development.scope: Reused development scenes; same predictor/per-decision rollout budget. Peak-coverage gain does not establish significant success-rate superiority.

engine_reference.scope: Known complete engine with extra structural prior; old training/development data, not learned-method or unseen control superiority.
